## About this site (kept up to date by Anchor)

This is a Jekyll site, edited in Anchor. Edit source files only; never `_site/`, `.git` or `.jekyll-cache`.
Every page and post is listed in @.anchor/sitemap.md. Check it before searching the repo.

- Permalink pattern: `/blog/:slug/`
- Layouts (`_layouts/`): default.html, post.html, top-100.html
- Includes (`_includes/`): author-bio.html, buy-button.html, cookie-banner.html, footer.html, header.html, popup.html, reading-list-carousel.html
- Data files (`_data/`): reading_lists
- Posts can belong to a topic hub through the `hub` front-matter field.
